metaTitle: How to Plan an RV Route
description: Plan an RV route step by step: rig measurements, daily mileage, road choice, fuel and rest stops, campground reservations and weather checks.
directAnswer: Start from your rig's height, weight and length, aim for 200 to 300 miles or 4 to 5 hours a day, route on big roads with an RV-aware navigator, reserve campgrounds, refuel at half a tank and arrive with daylight to spare.
